plasma_propulsion.description: Electric/plasma rocket thrust from power, efficiency, and Isp
plasma_propulsion.why: Need validated numbers for ion-drive performance without hand-calculating every time

rocket_stage_dv.description: Delta-v from wet mass, dry mass, and specific impulse
rocket_stage_dv.why: Avoid hand-computing the rocket equation for every stage design

escape_velocity.description: Escape velocity from a celestial body's mass and radius
escape_velocity.why: Reusable tool for comparing escape velocities across planets and moons without re-deriving the formula each time

circular_wing_aerodynamics.description: Aerodynamic analysis of circular wing configurations
circular_wing_aerodynamics.why: Need to understand lift/drag properties of non-conventional wing shapes

circular_wing_structure.description: Structural load analysis for circular wing designs
circular_wing_structure.why: Need to know if circular wing can survive aerodynamic forces

vtol_transition_mechanics.description: Transition mechanics analysis for VTOL aircraft
vtol_transition_mechanics.why: Need to understand if and how VTOL transition can work safely
